about: IphoneFM analog FM (D2). Every placed part with its designator, and every pin with its net. Source of truth: edit this file, then run python tools/netcheck.py.
notes: Designators U1-U7, J1, J2, SW1-SW3, D1, D3-D5, Y2, RV1-RV3, FB1-FB3, L1 and TP1-TP5 keep the names already used in bom.md, wiring.html and layout.html; gaps (D2, Y1) are parts dropped in earlier revisions.
Passives are numbered by chain order. ds_name gives the datasheet's own name where bom.md used it, so C24 is the LMX2571's loop-filter C1 and C32 is the Si4705's C1.
local_to names the pin a part must sit next to, for the placement check.
pinmap gives every pin of every part and the net it joins; "NC" marks a pin left open on purpose. A series part splits a net: the U1 side carries the suffix _MCU, a cathode side _K.
pad_nets join one part and a test pad only, on purpose (the SWD debug pads).
page_segments: the wiring page draws a net through its series parts (a resistor, capacitor, filter or ferrite) as one line; this maps each JSON net segment to the page net it belongs to.
